# Visible Windows & Doors

> Family-owned window and door company serving Southern California (San Diego, Los Angeles, and Orange County). We sell, install, service, and repair windows and doors — including replacement windows, new-construction windows, entry and patio doors, sliding and folding systems, screens, glass, and hardware. Licensed contractor (CSL #1150682) with a 5.0-star Google rating.

## About

- **Business:** Visible Windows & Doors
- **Type:** Window & door sales, installation, service, and repair
- **Ownership:** Family-owned and hands-on — the team that helps select the product is the same team that installs and services it
- **Service area:** Southern California — San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County
- **License:** California CSL #1150682
- **Rating:** 5.0 stars on Google (all reviews 5-star)
- **Specialization:** European-style window and door systems; service and maintenance for existing Albertini windows and doors (Albertini is a service specialty, not a current sales product line)
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- **Phone:** (858) 334-9071
- **Email:** contact@visiblewindowsanddoors.com

## Services

- **Sales:** Windows and doors for homeowners, remodelers, and contractors — replacement and new-construction windows, entry doors, patio doors, sliding and folding door systems.
- **Installation:** Replacement windows, new-construction windows, entry and patio doors, sliding and folding systems, lift-and-slide and multi-slide doors, bifold doors, and screens — including flashing and waterproofing.
- **Service & Repair:** Windows and doors that are hard to operate, damaged, misaligned, leaking, or not locking — rollers, tracks, handles, locks, glass, seals, and adjustments. Includes European tilt-and-turn hardware and existing Albertini systems.
- **Screens, Glass & Hardware:** Retractable and large-opening screens, screen repair, glass replacement, locks, handles, rollers, and tracks.
